# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster / Teacher at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

He glares sternly when discipline is disrupted in the classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

He is a lenient and somewhat inattentive supervisor who allows pupils to do as they please when distracted, though he can be stern when enforcing discipline or delivering severe punishments. He shows open favoritism toward older students like Prissy Andrews while harshly critiquing others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_

## Traits

- Stern  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- Inattentive  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching advanced subjects including Latin, geometry, French, and algebra  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school. During his time teaching, he frequently spent class time giving individualized instruction in algebra and Latin to Prissy Andrews while the rest of the school engaged in mischief unnoticed. On one occasion, after a classroom disruption following Gilbert Blythe teasing Anne Shirley, he glared sternly and disciplined the classroom. He oversaw the promotion of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe into the fifth class to study Latin, geometry, French, and algebra, though he bluntly criticized Anne as a dunce at geometry. Upon his eventual departure from the school, he gave a farewell speech to his students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_
